name: C1 · Avançado
description: Inversão e ênfase, collocations e registro, hedging e diplomacia, cleft sentences e nuances de vocabulário.

flashcards.back: Hardly/Rarely/Never/Seldom/Not only/No sooner + auxiliar + sujeito: Never have I seen...
flashcards.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
flashcards.syl: NÉ-ver rév ai sín sâtch â BIÚ-ti-fou plêis

flashcards.back: Hardly had I sat down when... · No sooner had I sat down than... (mal... e já).
flashcards.en: No sooner had I arrived than it started to rain.
flashcards.syl: nôu SÚ-ner réd ai â-RÁIVD dén it STÁR-tid tu réin

flashcards.back: Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
flashcards.en: Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
flashcards.syl: nót ôun-li did chi uín, bât chi ól-sôu brôuk dâ RÉ-kord

flashcards.back: Were I you... = If I were you · Had I known... = If I had known · Should you need... = If you should need...
flashcards.en: Had I known, I would have helped.
flashcards.syl: réd ai nôun, ai uúd rév rélpt

flashcards.back: make: decision, mistake, effort, progress, a suggestion. do: homework, the dishes, research, business, your best.
flashcards.en: I made a mistake, so I'll do my best to fix it.
flashcards.syl: ai mêid â mis-TÊIK, sôu áiu du mai BÉST tu fiks it

flashcards.back: take a break/risk/notes/place · have a look/a chat/an argument · get tired/better/the point/a refund.
flashcards.en: Let's take a break and have a look at the plan.
flashcards.syl: léts têik â brêik end rév â luk ét dâ plén

flashcards.en: Prices rise when costs are raised.
flashcards.syl: PRÁI-siz ráiz uén kósts ar réizd

flashcards.back: Formal: obtain, request, inform, in addition, regarding. Informal: get, ask for, tell, also, about. Evite contrações e phrasal verbs em textos formais.
flashcards.en: I would like to request further information.
flashcards.syl: ai uúd laik tu ri-KUÉST FÉR-der in-for-MÊI-chen

flashcards.back: Suavizar afirmações com might, seems, tends to, arguably, to some extent, para soar cuidadoso e diplomático.
flashcards.en: It seems that the results might suggest a problem.
flashcards.syl: it símz dét dâ ri-SÂLTS máit sâ-DJÉST â PRÓ-blem

flashcards.back: I might be wrong, but... / I wonder if we could... / Perhaps it would be better to...
flashcards.en: I wonder if we could try a different approach.
flashcards.syl: ai UÂN-der if uí kúd trai â DÍ-fe-rent â-PRÔUTCH

flashcards.back: I'm afraid I can't... / Unfortunately, I won't be able to... / I'd love to, but...
flashcards.en: I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't make it.
flashcards.syl: aid lâv tu, bât aim â-FRÉID ai ként mêik it

flashcards.back: It was ... that/who ...: enfatiza uma parte. It was John who called me. / It was not until later that I realized.
flashcards.en: It was not until midnight that he finished.
flashcards.syl: it uóz nót ân-TÍU mid-NÁIT dét ri FÍ-nicht

flashcards.back: What I need is... / What happened was... Enfatiza o que vem depois do 'is/was'.
flashcards.en: What I need is a long vacation.
flashcards.syl: uót ai nid iz â lóng vê-KÊI-chen

flashcards.back: Depois de demand, insist, suggest, recommend: that + sujeito + verbo base: I suggest that he go.
flashcards.en: I suggest that she be on time.
flashcards.syl: ai sâ-DJÉST dét chi bí on táim

flashcards.back: affect (verbo) = afetar. effect (substantivo) = efeito. (Raramente: effect como verbo = efetuar.)
flashcards.en: The weather affects my mood, and the effect is clear.
flashcards.syl: dâ UÉ-der â-FÉKTS mai mud, end dí i-FÉKT iz klír

flashcards.back: economic = da economia · economical = econômico (barato) · historic = importante na história · historical = relativo à história.
flashcards.en: It was a historic moment in economic history.
flashcards.syl: it uóz â ris-TÓ-rik MÔU-ment in E-kâ-NÓ-mik RÍS-tâ-ri

flashcards.back: eventually = por fim (não 'eventualmente') · actually = na verdade (não 'atualmente') · currently = atualmente.
flashcards.en: Eventually, I got the job. I'm currently working there.
flashcards.syl: i-VÉN-tchu-â-li, ai gót dâ djob · aim KÂ-rent-li UÉR-king dér

questions.question: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
questions.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

questions.question: No sooner ___ arrived than it started to rain.
Not only ___ she win, but she also broke the record.
questions.explanation: Not only did she win (inversão no passado).

questions.question: ___ I known, I would have acted differently.
questions.explanation: Had I known = If I had known.

questions.question: We must ___ a decision before Monday.
He ___ his best to finish on time.
Which sentence is the most formal?
options: Can you get me the report?
Could you send me the report?
I would be grateful if you could provide the report.
questions.explanation: 'I would be grateful if you could...' é o mais formal.

questions.question: Which is the most diplomatic way to point out an error?
options: I might be mistaken, but I think there may be an error here.

questions.question: Which phrase is a polite refusal?
options: I'm afraid I won't be able to make it.
questions.explanation: 'I'm afraid I won't be able to...' recusa com delicadeza.

questions.question: 'The results suggest that...' é mais cauteloso que:
options: The results might suggest that possibly...

questions.question: It was not until midnight ___ he finished.
___ I need is a long vacation.
I suggest that he ___ on time.
'Eventually' means:
options: in the end, after a long time
